name: Nanchang Sanrui Intelligence Technology Co., Ltd. Class A
summary: Nanchang Sanrui Intelligence Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of electric power systems for civilian drones and robots. The company is also actively developing electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) power systems. The firm's products include electric power systems, including motors, electronic speed regulators, propellers and integrated power systems. Its brands include: LIGPOWER, T-HOBBY, CUBEMARS, SUPER-E and MEPSKING. The company was founded by Wan Zhi Jian, Wan Kai, Xiong Cheng Xiang and Wu Jie on October 14, 2009 and is headquartered in Nanchang, China.
